title: Structures of the cyanobacterial nitrogen regulators NtcA and PipX complexed to DNA fully clarify DNA binding by NtcA and recruitment of RNA polymerase by PipX
authors: Alicia Forcada-Nadal; Sirine Bibak; Paloma Salinas; Asunción Contreras; Vicente Rubio; José L. Llácer
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构、建模与功能实验阐明蓝藻转录因子NtcA与DNA的特异性结合及PipX共激活机制，虽以实验结构为主、AI/物理模拟方法有限，但核心聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，对本课题有直接参考价值。
abstract: The CRP-FNR superfamily of transcriptional regulators includes the cyanobacterial master regulator NtcA, which orchestrates large responses of cyanobacteria to nitrogen scarcity. NtcA uses as allosteric activator 2-oxoglutarate (2OG), a signal of nitrogen poorness and carbon richness, and binds a coactivating protein (PipX) that shuttles between the signaling protein PII and NtcA depending on nitrogen richness, thus connecting PII signaling and gene expression regulation. Here, combining structural (X-ray crystallography of six types of crystals including NtcA complexes with DNA, 2OG and PipX), modelling and functional (EMSA and bacterial two-hybrid) studies, we clarify the reasons for the exquisite specificity for the binding of NtcA to its target DNA, its mechanisms of activation by 2OG, and its coactivation by PipX. Our crystal structures of PipX-NtcA-DNA complexes prove that PipX does not interact with DNA, although it increases NtcA-DNA contacts, and that it stabilizes the active, DNA-binding-competent conformation of NtcA. Superimposition of this complex on a very recently reported cryoEM structure of NtcA in a Transcription Activity Complex with RNA polymerase (RNAP), shows that PipX binding helps recruit RNAP by PipX interaction with RNAP, particularly with its gamma and sigma (region 4) subunits, a structural prediction supported here by bacterial two-hybrid experiments.
abstract_zh: CRP-FNR超家族转录调控因子包括蓝细菌主调控因子NtcA，其协调蓝细菌对氮缺乏的大规模响应。NtcA利用2-氧代戊二酸（2OG）作为变构激活剂，该分子是氮贫乏和碳丰富的信号，并结合一种共激活蛋白（PipX），该蛋白根据氮丰富度在信号蛋白PII和NtcA之间穿梭，从而连接PII信号传导与基因表达调控。在此，我们结合结构（包括NtcA与DNA、2OG和PipX复合物的六种晶体的X射线晶体学）、建模和功能（EMSA和细菌双杂交）研究，阐明了NtcA对其靶DNA结合的高度特异性的原因、其由2OG激活的机制以及由PipX共激活的机制。我们的PipX-NtcA-DNA复合物晶体结构证明，PipX不与DNA相互作用，尽管它增加了NtcA-DNA接触，并且它稳定了NtcA的活性、具备DNA结合能力构象。将该复合物与最近报道的NtcA在含RNA聚合酶（RNAP）的转录活性复合物中的冷冻电镜结构叠加显示，PipX结合通过PipX与RNAP（特别是其γ和σ（区域4）亚基）的相互作用帮助招募RNAP，这一结构预测得到了此处细菌双杂交实验的支持。
